cues.text: Maya needs help setting up a weekend community event.
Instead of a vague post, she opens the Job Brief Builder.
She describes the task in one sentence, then picks a category, the work mode, a general area and her budget.
The builder turns that into a structured brief: a clear title, the scope, step by step tasks with acceptance criteria, and safety notes.
Maya applies it to the form, sets the title and her six hundred peso offer, and publishes.
Within seconds, the gig is live.
Every field stays editable before it goes live.
